verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference and API platform for coding agents. A platform like this could plausibly offer background automations, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no way to set up autonomous or scheduled automations. The standby service tier is only a discounted, deprioritized request tier for the user's own batch and background workloads. Async Reflex training jobs and canary traffic splits are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not product-run automations.
